⚡ Snowden SAY Deep Systems Engineering Lab: Ежедневные глубокие разборы аварий на проде, деградация внимания LLM (Lost in the Middle), rolling memory compactor и low-level агентные рантаймы — в нашем Telegram-канале: @snowdensay.

⚡ Architectural Manifesto

Modern LLMs with 128k–1M token context windows create a dangerous illusion of infinite memory. In long autonomous agent runs (40+ tool turns), attention weights irreversibly dilute across the KV cache (Lost in the Middle).

  1. Never summarize failed tool calls: Raw error tracebacks must remain verbatim until fixed, or the agent cycles infinitely.
  2. Grammar-constrained decoding over prompt validation: Enforce JSON Schemas via CFG logits masks prior to softmax (99.97% validity vs 92% with prompt prompting).
  3. Lock your compaction routines: Parallel tool invocations in async loops trigger race conditions and double-compaction without asyncio.Lock.

1. Agent Memory & Context Compaction

Three-tier rolling compaction architecture:

[ LAYER 1: Pinned Invariants ] ─── System contract, safety boundaries, tools (Raw, 0% drop)
           │
[ LAYER 2: Compacted Ledger ]  ─── Deduplicated facts of completed successful tool cycles
           │
[ LAYER 3: Hot Raw Tail ]      ─── Last 4-6 turns (Fresh local state + unresolved stacktraces)
  • Reference Implementations:
    • RollingMemoryCompactor (Python/Go): Automatic deduplication of idempotent file reads (head, cat) into SHA256 pointers.
    • Episodic KV Cache Offloading: Pruning intermediate layer KV tokens for background context.

2. Schema-Constrained Decoding & Grammar Engines

  • xgrammar: Fast GPU-accelerated grammar-guided decoding for vLLM and SGLang.
  • outlines: Structured text generation via finite-state machine (FSM) index over model vocabulary.
  • guidance: Interleaved generation and control logic with token-level regex constraints.

Production Example (vLLM + xgrammar):

from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
from vllm.sampling_params import GuidedDecodingParams

schema = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "tool": {"enum": ["patch_ast", "execute_test", "commit_fix"]},
        "file_path": {"type": "string", "pattern": r"^[\w\-\./]+\.[a-z]+$"},
        "patch_content": {"type": "string"}
    },
    "required": ["tool", "file_path", "patch_content"],
    "additionalProperties": False
}

params = SamplingParams(
    temperature=0.1,
    max_tokens=1024,
    guided_decoding=GuidedDecodingParams(json=schema)
)

3. SWE-bench & Automated AST Code Editing

  • Tree-sitter: Incremental concrete syntax tree parsing for AST-aware diffing.
  • SWE-bench: Benchmark for evaluating LLMs on resolving real-world GitHub issues.
  • Syntactic Rollback Guards: Reverting invalid patches at parse-time before invoking compilers.

4. MCP (Model Context Protocol) Hardening

  • Prompt Injection Defense in Tools: Strict sanitization of dynamic tool definitions from untrusted MCP servers.
  • Zombie Process Reaper: Automatic cleanup of stdio subprocesses exceeding idle TTL.
  • Concurrency Rate Limiting: Non-blocking select token buckets to prevent LLM retry stampedes.

5. Sandboxing & Isolation

  • gVisor: Application kernel for container security, intercepting Linux syscalls in user space.
  • Firecracker: Ephemeral microVMs booting in < 5 ms for untrusted Python code execution.
  • nsjail: Lightweight Linux process isolation tool using namespaces and seccomp-bpf.

6. Benchmarks & Real Production Metrics

Tested on SWE-bench Verified subset (17,000 tool iterations/day, Llama-3.3-70B on 4×A100):

Metric Naive Context Buffer Linear Summarization Rolling Compaction (Ours)
System Rules Recall 68.2% 74.5% 97.8%
Token Cost Per Run 1.84M 1.12M 0.62M (-66%)
Infinite Loop Failures 14.3% 9.8% 0.2%
p99 Execution Latency 4.8s 8.2s 1.9s

oneSentenceSummary: 该代码库精选了用于构建可靠 AI 智能体基础设施的架构规范、记忆压缩技术、模式约束解码工具和 SWE-bench 评测。
summary: 本文介绍了一套精选的 AI 智能体基础设施组件，重点关注三个核心挑战：记忆管理、结构化输出生成和代码编辑能力。文章介绍了一种三层滚动式智能体记忆压缩架构，既能保留系统约束，又能对已完成的工具调用周期进行去重。文中详细说明了如何使用 xgrammar、outlines 和 guidance 等工具进行语法约束解码：与基于提示词的方法相比，这类工具可将 JSON 有效率提升至 99.97%，而后者为 92%。文章还介绍了面向 AST 感知代码编辑的 SWE-bench 评测，以及带有语法回滚保护的代码编辑方法。该代码库也探讨了 MCP 协议加固、使用 gVisor 和 Firecracker 进行沙箱隔离，并展示了基准测试结果：系统规则召回率达到 97.8%，与朴素方法相比，token 成本降低 66%。

mainPoints.point: 三层滚动式记忆压缩架构
mainPoints.explanation: 采用分层方案：保留固定不变的约束（系统约束、安全边界），维护经过压缩并去重的事实记录，同时保留近期对话的原始内容作为热数据，以缓解智能体长时间运行时的注意力稀释问题。

mainPoints.point: 用于结构化输出的语法约束解码
mainPoints.explanation: xgrammar、outlines 和 guidance 等工具会在 softmax 之前通过 CFG logits 掩码强制遵守 JSON Schema。与基于提示词的验证方法相比，其有效率达到 99.97%，而后者为 92%。

mainPoints.point: 带语法回滚保护的 AST 感知代码编辑
mainPoints.explanation: 使用 Tree-sitter 增量解析具体语法树，从而支持 SWE-bench 评测；在调用编译器之前，系统会在解析阶段自动撤销无效补丁。

mainPoints.point: MCP 协议加固与进程隔离
mainPoints.explanation: 通过实现提示词注入防护、僵尸进程回收和并发速率限制，保护动态工具定义，并防止 LLM 重试请求激增。

mainPoints.point: 基准测试结果显示性能提升
mainPoints.explanation: 滚动式压缩实现了 97.8% 的系统规则召回率，将 token 成本降低 66%（0.62M 对比 1.84M tokens），无限循环故障率为 0.2%，p99 延迟为 1.9s；相比之下，朴素方法的延迟为 4.8s。

keyQuotes: 具备 128k--1M token 上下文窗口的现代 LLM，造成了一种危险的错觉，让人以为记忆可以无限延伸。
与提示词验证相比，语法约束解码可在 softmax 之前通过 CFG logits 掩码强制遵守 JSON Schema（有效率为 99.97%，而提示词引导的方法为 92%）。
绝不要总结失败的工具调用：原始错误回溯必须保持原样，直到问题修复，否则智能体会陷入无限循环。
